heading: EXT. ABERNETHY GREEN - REENACTMENT CAMPGROUND - DAY

units.text: EXT. ABERNETHY GREEN - REENACTMENT CAMPGROUND - DAY
A muddy field of canvas tents.
Smoke from a cookfire.
Thaddeus Pell, 40s, in a full 1776 militia coat and tricorn, sits on a barrel holding a laptop wrapped in a burlap sack.
He is very aware of the modern world and very hopeful nobody sees it.
Philippa Voight, 30s, in a plain linen gown and apron, walks up carrying a wooden bucket.
She stops.
Squints.
Are you ColonelHuzzah88?
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: Are you Mistress_Quill?
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: Yes, hi. Thaddeus. Hi.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: Philippa! In the flesh! Well, in the flax.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: She sets down the bucket.
They shake hands, awkwardly, formally, as period requires.
ON LAPTOP SCREEN: a Slack channel titled #the-1776-crew.
The newest message reads:
ON SCREEN: wick_the_unbothered: are u 2 there yet or what
Wick's online. They said they'd join by video, they couldn't get off work.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: Thaddeus unwraps the burlap and turns the laptop so both can see.
A video window opens: a cluttered cubicle, a lanyard, a fluorescent light.
WICK, 20s, wears a headset and a cheap tricorn made of black construction paper.
Oh my god, you're real. Hi! Is that the real mud?
units.name: WICK

units.text: It's the real mud.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: I'm so sorry I'm not there, my manager is literally behind me, they keep walking past. One sec.
units.name: WICK

units.text: Wick quickly minimizes a spreadsheet and sits very straight.
You look very serious.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: I'm in a meeting. Technically. I'm muted, I think? Am I muted?
units.name: WICK

units.text: No.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: Oh no. (muttering) Okay. Okay. It's fine.
units.name: WICK

units.text: Philippa sits on the grass, tucks her skirts.
Thaddeus offers her a hard biscuit from a leather pouch.
Is it period?
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: It's from Costco. But I dipped it in tea so it looks old.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: That's the most you thing I've ever heard and I've known you for two years in text.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: Aw, you guys are cute. This is cute. I'm gonna cry at my desk.
units.name: WICK

units.text: Please don't cry at your desk, Wick.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: I use they/them, Thaddeus, not "cry at your desk," come on.
units.name: WICK

units.text: A beat.
Then all three laugh.
A distant musket goes off POP over the tents.
Philippa bites the biscuit and winces.
Okay. That's definitely Costco.
units.name: PHILIPPA
